"""Near-limit batch construction and timing."""
import json
import random
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')

rng = random.Random(4)
definitions = [['D%d' % i, 'b"%s" * %d' % ('abcdefgh'[:1 + i % 8], 1 + i % 5)]
               for i in range(400)]
cases = []
pairs_used = 0
frames_total = 0
for index in range(2000):
    frames = []
    for position in range(20):
        kind = ['headers', 'data', 'datagram', 'sleep'][position % 4]
        if kind == 'sleep':
            frames.append({'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': position % 3})
        elif kind == 'headers':
            rows = []
            for k in range(4 if pairs_used + 4 <= 32768 else 1):
                pairs_used += 1
                rows.append([':name%d' % k, '{{D%d}}' % ((index + k) % len(definitions))])
            frames.append({'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': rows,
                           'End_Stream': position == 19})
        else:
            frames.append({'Type': kind,
                           'data_to_transfered': 'body<<random_string>>%d' % position})
    frames_total += len(frames)
    cases.append({'name': 'case%04d' % index, 'frames': frames,
                  'expect': {'method': 'GET', 'target': '/a%d' % index,
                             'host': 'h%d.example' % index}})
events = []
for index in range(4000):
    if index % 40 == 39:
        events.append({'at': index % 30, 'kind': 'close'})
        continue
    events.append({'at': index % 30, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': (index * 4) % 8000,
                   'end': index % 3 == 0, 'data': 'resp<<random_string>>'})
    pairs_used += 0
channel = []
blob = []
for index in range(20000):
    blob.append('GET /a%d HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h%d.example\r\nX-A: b\r\n\r\n' % (index, index))
text = ''.join(blob)
parts = []
step = max(1, len(text) // 4000)
offset = 0
while offset < len(text):
    parts.append({'case': 'case%04d' % (offset % 2000), 'data': text[offset:offset + step]})
    offset += step
channels = [{'name': 'edge%03d' % index,
             'parts': parts if index == 0 else [{'case': None, 'data': ''}]}
            for index in range(64)]
doc = {'seed': 'stress', 'definitions': definitions, 'timeout_ms': 1000,
       'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels}
raw = json.dumps(doc)
open('/workspace/tmp/t/stress.json', 'w').write(raw)
print('frames', frames_total, 'events', len(events), 'parts', sum(len(c['parts']) for c in channels),
      'pairs', pairs_used, 'bytes', len(raw.encode()))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp/t && python3 stress.py && ls -la stress.json | awk '{print $5}'
